caseName: City of Tacoma v. Taxpayers of Tacoma
caseNameFull: City of Tacoma v. Taxpayers of Tacoma, Washington
attorneys: Solicitor General Rankin for the Federal Power Commission, movant.

opinions.text: Certiorari, 355 U. S. 888, to the Supreme Court of Washington. The motion of the Solicitor General for leave to participate in oral argument, as amicus curiae, is granted and one-half hour is allowed for that purpose.
